summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only verification of two new features on OLI Customer User Panel: (1) auto feedback popup on completed service pages with star-based response messaging and mandatory redirect to /recommended, and (2) new dashboard highlighted banner with clickable 'Recommended Services' orange link. All flows (A, B, C, D, E, F) executed successfully. Auto popup opens only for completed services without existing feedback, stars 1-3 show sad icon + negative message, stars 4-5 show positive message, and every rating leads to /recommended (via auto-redirect ~2.5s and via feedback-view-reco-btn). Non-completed services do not auto-open the popup. Dashboard banner renders with expected copy and its orange link navigates to /recommended on both desktop (1920px) and mobile (390px) viewports. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: localStorage persistence is debounced 250ms in store.jsx; safe here, but could lose latest state on abrupt tab close immediately after an action.
ServiceDetail useEffect dependency array uses `svc && svc.oliId` etc. which is safe but the eslint-disable is a small code smell; consider `svc?.oliId`.
seed_data_creation: Used Profile > Reset Demo Data to restore un-submitted completed services between rating runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features working. Auto feedback trigger lives in /app/frontend/src/pages/ServiceDetail.jsx (600ms delay). Auto redirect to /recommended lives in FeedbackModal in /app/frontend/src/oli/modals.jsx (2500ms). Store persists with a 250ms debounce so if querying localStorage in tests, wait >250ms after mutation. Note: first Flow F attempt showed a false-positive re-open because localStorage state from a previous session run persisted feedback for a different service; using Reset Demo Data before the rating loop yields a clean run.
